s.g: Suffix used to form nouns from other nouns, usually referring to inhabitants of a given place or occupations.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see а (a), так (tak).
to flap, to wave, to strike (with), to make strokes (with)
guitarist (person playing or performing on the guitar)
to hit, to strike, to clip, to give it to someone
to estimate someone's age from their appearance
ass, arse (the buttocks of a person or animal)
to marry off (to arrange the marriage of someone (typically of a male relative))
draw, drawing, sortition (procedure by which the result of a lottery is determined)
to become mossy, to become covered or overgrown with moss
to skin over, to heal (of wounds)
to be delayed, to be dragged out
croak, ribbit: an imitation of the sound made by a frog.
a clapping game, similar to pattycake
alternative form of лады́ (ladý); okay, alright
to be outlined, to take shape, to begin to show
to be planned, to be in the offing
to break off (to separate a piece from a whole by breaking)
to make over, to alter (to change the form or structure of)
to flutter, to fly, to stream
to scatter, to disperse, to dissipate
North Ossetia (a republic and federal subject of Russia, located in the Northern Caucasus mountains; in full, Се́верная Осе́тия-Ала́ния (Sévernaja Osétija-Alánija); short form Ала́ния (Alánija))
to shine, to beam, to be radiant
to harness together (a beast of burden), to yoke together (an ox)
to shirk, to elude, to weasel out
emphatic of целый (celyj): intact, without a scratch
